description: invented timeline and reassurance for an unresolved issue

email.subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – course video loading issue
email.body_text:
Hi Meera,

Thank you for your time on our call. I understand how frustrating this has been, and I'm sorry for the trouble. You wanted help with course videos that keep loading for some of your students, mostly on their phones. Here is a quick summary so you have everything in one place.

What we covered:
- We checked an affected lesson on several browsers and a phone and could not reproduce the problem from our side.

Your next steps:
1. Ask one affected student to record a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.

What we'll do next:
- Our technical team will look into this and fix it within 24 hours. You will hear from us soon.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-03

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
